items.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015
items.q: I subbed for the guitar player on the Three Suns, Morty (sic) [Al] Nevins, and I took his place... I ended up playing with them for two years.

ctx.x: Oh that’s so interesting to me.

Well I figured the life of a musician comes in phases. It started with the big bands for me. I thought when the band broke up that was the end of the world. It wasn’t. I went on staff, I did the “Kate Smith Show.” While I was on the “Kate Smith Show” I subbed for the guitar player on the Three Suns, Morty (sic) [Al] Nevins, and I took his place. I put his tux on and I appeared as him. And I ended up playing with them for two years. I went to Vegas the first six weeks we were married we were in Vegas and we played…
